general_ngo_rules: Wash, dry, and neatly fold all garments before drop-off — NGOs cannot distribute soiled clothes.
Tie shoes in pairs and bundle small cables, stationery, or accessories in labeled bags.
For electronics (phones/laptops), sign out of Google/Apple/Mi accounts and factory reset first.
Never donate swollen batteries, leaking cells, or broken hazardous e-waste — take those strictly to a CPCB/MPCB authorised collector.
Call ahead to confirm current NGO intake hours and capacity before traveling.
